title: SASSA Appeal Guide
description: Step-by-step guide to appealing a declined SASSA grant decision.

seo.metaTitle: SASSA Appeal Guide — How to Appeal a Declined Grant
seo.metaDescription: Complete guide to SASSA grant appeals: timeline, required documents, how to submit, and what outcomes to expect. 90-day appeal window.

contentBlocks.text: If SASSA declines your grant application, you have the right to appeal. The appeal must be submitted within 90 days of receiving the decline notification.
